title: unified-rollouts: enhance canary/A-B/shadow autorollback with multi-metric quorum and safety guards
author: Ava Chen
description: Motivation: improve rollout safety for canary/A-B and shadow flows by introducing a multi-metric quorum-based autorollback engine, stronger preflight probes, and tighter observability/safety guards. This PR implements: 1) A multi-metric quorum policy that requires a user-configurable quorum of metric checks (latency p95, error rate, relevance/regression score) to trigger automatic rollback instead of single-metric thresholds; 2) Preflight probing stage that runs short synthetic traffic against candidate variants and gates rollout automatically if probes fail; 3) Quarantine stage support that isolates unhealthy traffic slices for manual review; 4) Enhanced telemetry that emits per-stage telemetry (probe_pass/fail, quorum_votes, rollback_reason) and ties into the rollout dashboard and alerts; 5) E2E integration tests and a stability matrix for canary weights and sequence lengths; 6) Backwards-compatible config schema and migration notes. Backwards compatibility: existing simple threshold policies continue to work; new fields are additive. Rollout plan: merge to main, deploy to staging for 48h with feature flag rollout.autorollback.v2=true, run canary experiments with production-like traffic shape, then flip flag in production if no regressions observed. See linked Linear tickets for rollout milestones.
commits: Initial multi-metric quorum engine and policy model
Add preflight probing stage and gating logic
Quarantine stage implementation and admin endpoints
Telemetry: emit probe and quorum metrics
Add e2e tests and update rollout harness
Fix: use bounded retry for probe sidecar
Docs: rollout policy schema and examples
Tests: flake fixes and CI optimizations
review_comments: Priya Nair: This looks solid. Please clarify how quorum weights are computed for mixed metric types (error rate vs latency).

Ava Chen (author): Quorum uses normalized scoring: metrics are normalized to 0..1 using historical baselines. We added comments and examples in the policy docs and a normalization helper function in quorum_policy.rs
Miguel Torres: Request change: preflight probe timeouts should be bounded and configurable per-environment to avoid blocking rollouts in noisy networks
Ava Chen (author): Updated probe retry/backoff and added env var controls. Added tests for probe timing behavior
Omar Khalid: Observability: can we tag quorum metrics with rollout_id and probe_stage so dashboards can filter by release? Also add a short retention note for high-cardinality labels
Ava Chen (author): Added rollout_id and stage labels, and added a note to alerts describing retention trade-offs. Marked telemetry labels as optional to avoid high-cardinality by default
release_notes: Enhancement: multi-metric quorum autorollback for unified rollouts. Adds preflight probes, quarantine stage, and enhanced telemetry. Backwards-compatible policy schema. See docs/rollouts/autorollback.md for migration guide.
